items.title: Bloomberg This Weekend 8/08/2026
items.content: The news doesn’t stop when markets close. Hosts David Gura, Christina Ruffini and Lisa Mateo bring clarity, context and a bit of humor to the weekend’s biggest headlines, LIVE from New York. Joined by Oxford Centre on Migration, Policy & Society Senior Researcher Myriam Cherti, Merrill & Bank of America Head of Market Strategy Joe Quinlan, the New Yorker Staff Writer and Author “Age of Ambition” Evan Osnos and Sportswriter & “LIV and Let Die” Author Alan Shipnuck. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Zelenskyy Wins Serbian Pledges as Russian Influence Wanes
items.content: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy made a landmark first visit on Saturday to Serbia to expand cooperation with the Balkan country whose leader has been scaling back once-close ties with Russia.
items.contentSnippet: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy made a landmark first visit on Saturday to Serbia to expand cooperation with the Balkan country whose leader has been scaling back once-close ties with Russia.
items.creator: Misha Savic and Olesia Safronova

summaries.zh: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基周六对塞尔维亚进行历史性首次访问。塞尔维亚近年来逐渐减少与俄罗斯的一贯紧密关系。此次访问标志着两国关系的转折点，也体现了俄罗斯在巴尔干地区影响力减弱的趋势。
summaries.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy is visiting Serbia for the first time on Saturday. Serbia has been reducing its close ties with Russia. The trip marks a significant moment as Russian influence in the Balkans wanes.

items.title: Private Credit Squeezed By Bank Refinancings: Credit Weekly
items.content: Highly-indebted companies are increasingly ditching private credit loans for cheaper capital in the bank loan market, a shift underscoring the stark realities of higher-for-longer interest rates.
items.contentSnippet: Highly-indebted companies are increasingly ditching private credit loans for cheaper capital in the bank loan market, a shift underscoring the stark realities of higher-for-longer interest rates.
items.creator: Aaron Weinman and Rachel Graf

summaries.zh:
银行再融资导致私募信贷承压：信贷周报  
高负债企业正转向银行贷款市场寻求更便宜的资本，减少对私募信贷的依赖。这一转变凸显了利率持续走高的严峻现实。
summaries.en: Private credit is declining as highly-indebted companies favor cheaper bank loans amid higher-for-longer interest rates. This shift highlights financial pressures on indebted firms seeking more affordable capital.

items.title: LIV Golf Tries to Survive Without Saudi Billions
items.content: LIV Golf is seeking fresh investments as it prepares to cut purses and move away from the huge guaranteed payments that helped it lure some of golf’s biggest stars. Author of "LIV or Let Die" Alan Shipnuck is on Bloomberg This Weekend to explain that the league’s future may depend on retaining players including Jon Rahm and Bryson DeChambeau while proving it can attract enough fans and revenue to operate with less financial support from Saudi Arabia. (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: LIV高尔夫正寻求新投资，准备削减奖金并减少沙特阿拉伯的巨额资金支持。作者艾伦·希普尼克在彭博社节目中指出，该联盟的未来可能取决于留住包括琼·拉姆和布莱森·德尚博等球星，同时证明其能吸引足够粉丝和收入独立运营。
summaries.en: LIV Golf is seeking new funding as it plans to reduce prize money and relies less on Saudi Arabia's financial support. The league aims to retain top players like Jon Rahm and Bryson DeChambeau while proving it can generate sufficient revenue independently. Author Alan Shipnuck discussed this on Bloomberg, emphasizing the importance of balancing player retention and financial sustainability. (65 words)

items.title: China’s AI Push Reshapes Its Economic Future
items.content: New Yorker staff writer Evan Osnos is on Bloomberg This Weekend and says China is taking a practical approach to AI, rapidly deploying the technology in factories and seeking to expand its use across emerging markets rather than focusing primarily on the pursuit of artificial general intelligence. (Source: Bloomberg)
items.contentSnippet: New Yorker staff writer Evan Osnos is on Bloomberg This Weekend and says China is taking a practical approach to AI, rapidly deploying the technology in factories and seeking to expand its use across emerging markets rather than focusing primarily on the pursuit of artificial general intelligence. (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: 《纽约客》员工Evan Osnos在彭博社表示，中国正以实用主义态度推进人工智能，快速将其应用于工厂，并寻求在新兴市场扩大应用范围，而非主要追求通用人工智能。
summaries.en: China is adopting a practical approach to AI, focusing on rapid deployment in factories and expanding its use in emerging markets rather than prioritizing artificial general intelligence. This strategy aims to drive economic growth by integrating AI into industrial and developing economies. (60 words)

items.title: WuXi AppTec Gets Temporary Reprieve of Chinese Military Curb
items.content: A US judge blocked the Defense Department from enforcing its designation of WuXi AppTec Co. as a Chinese military company, granting temporary relief to the major pharmaceutical contractor.
items.contentSnippet: A US judge blocked the Defense Department from enforcing its designation of WuXi AppTec Co. as a Chinese military company, granting temporary relief to the major pharmaceutical contractor.
items.creator: Suvashree Ghosh and Kate O'Keeffe

summaries.zh: 美国法官阻止了美国国防部对药明康德公司实施“中国军事企业”的认定，为其争取到了临时救济。
summaries.en: A U.S. judge blocked the Defense Department from enforcing its designation of WuXi AppTec Co. as a Chinese military company, granting temporary relief to the major pharmaceutical contractor. The ruling provides a temporary reprieve from the label, which had been imposed due to concerns over WuXi's ties to Chinese state-owned enterprises. The judge's decision allows WuXi AppTec to continue operating without immediate enforcement of the designation, pending further legal review.

items.title: US Munitions Strain Complicates Iran Strategy
items.content: The US remains outside formal negotiations with Iran as Oman and Tehran discuss arrangements for the Strait of Hormuz, leaving the diplomatic path uncertain and raising the possibility of renewed fighting. Joining Bloomberg This Weekend, Bloomberg News White House & National Security Editor Michelle Jamrisko explains to David Gura and Christina Ruffini that strains on US munitions supplies are complicating Washington’s options, with the Pentagon pushing defense contractors to accelerate production while balancing weapons needs across Iran, Ukraine and other potential conflicts. (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.en: The US is not involved in formal negotiations with Iran as Oman and Tehran discuss Strait of Hormuz arrangements, creating diplomatic uncertainty and risking renewed conflict. Strains on US munitions supplies complicate Washington's strategy, as the Pentagon urges defense contractors to boost production while balancing weapons needs for Iran, Ukraine, and other potential conflicts. (58 words)

items.title: Hunting Camo Moves From the Woods to Runways
items.content: Hunting camouflage has moved from the woods into mainstream fashion, fueled by demand for vintage workwear and rural American aesthetics. Bloomberg Weekend Senior Features Writer Madison Darbyshire is on Bloomberg This Weekend to explain how the trend has reached streetwear and luxury fashion, where inexpensive hunting gear can inspire pieces costing thousands of dollars and give urban consumers a way to adopt the imagery of traditional masculinity and blue-collar culture. (Source: Bloomberg)

(Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: University of California Faculty Push to Bring Back SAT and ACT Score Consideration
items.content: Thousands of University of California faculty members are pushing the system to reconsider its test free admissions policy, arguing that SAT and ACT scores could help identify students prepared for college-level work as concerns grow about grade inflation and AI use. Bloomberg News Education Policy Reporter Liam Knox explains to hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini that the university has launched a faculty-led review, but opponents argue standardized tests can reinforce socioeconomic disparities, and UC says no change will affect students applying for fall 2027 admission. (Source: Bloomberg)
items.contentSnippet: Thousands of University of California faculty members are pushing the system to reconsider its test free admissions policy, arguing that SAT and ACT scores could help identify students prepared for college-level work as concerns grow about grade inflation and AI use. Bloomberg News Education Policy Reporter Liam Knox explains to hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini that the university has launched a faculty-led review, but opponents argue standardized tests can reinforce socioeconomic disparities, and UC says no change will affect students applying for fall 2027 admission. (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: 加州大学数千名教职工呼吁重新考虑免标化考试录取政策，认为SAT和ACT成绩有助于评估学生是否具备大学水平能力，因对成绩膨胀和AI使用的担忧加剧。尽管大学启动了教师主导的审查，但反对者认为标准化考试会加剧社会经济不平等。加州大学表示，政策变更不影响2027年秋季入学的申请者。（源自彭博社）
summaries.en: Thousands of University of California faculty members are urging the system to reconsider its test-free admissions policy. They argue that SAT and ACT scores could help assess students' readiness for college-level work amid concerns about grade inflation and AI use. While the university has launched a faculty-led review, opponents contend standardized tests perpetuate socioeconomic disparities. UC has clarified that any changes will not impact students applying for fall 2027 admission. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: CEO Greg Abel Starts Making His Mark at Berkshire
items.content: Berkshire Hathaway stepped up spending under CEO Greg Abel, repurchasing about $4.5 billion of its shares while deploying billions more into investments. Bloomberg Intelligence and Senior P&C Insurance Equity Analyst Matthew Palazola is on Bloomberg This Weekend explaining to hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini that Abel appears more focused on operations and putting Berkshire’s enormous cash reserves to work, marking an early shift from Warren Buffett’s final years at the helm. (Source: Bloomberg)

Bloomberg Intelligence and Senior P&C Insurance Equity Analyst Matthew Palazola is on Bloomberg This Weekend explaining to hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini that Abel appears more focused on operations and putting Berkshire’s enormous cash reserves to work, marking an early shift from Warren Buffett’s final years at the helm. summaries.zh: 伯克希尔哈撒韦在CEO格雷格·阿布尔的领导下加大支出，回购约45亿美元股票，同时投入数十亿美元进行投资。据彭博报道，分析师认为阿布尔更注重运营，并将伯克希尔庞大的现金储备用于实际工作，这与沃伦·巴菲特最后几年领导公司的策略有所转变。
summaries.en: Under CEO Greg Abel, Berkshire Hathaway increased spending by repurchasing $4.5 billion in shares and deploying additional billions in investments. This shift reflects a greater focus on operations and utilizing Berkshire's substantial cash reserves, marking a change from Warren Buffett's final years. Abel's approach highlights a more active use of the company's resources, according to Bloomberg Intelligence and分析师 Matthew Palazola.

items.title: AI Buildout Keeps Quinlan Bullish on US Stocks
items.content: Merrill & Bank of America Head of Market Strategy Joe Quinlan is on Bloomberg This Weekend to give his reaction to the July jobs report. Quinlan explains to hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini that the US economy remains resilient despite the weak July jobs data, pointing to continued hiring in construction and health care and investment tied to AI. (Source: Bloomberg)

Quinlan explains to hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini that the US economy remains resilient despite the weak July jobs data, pointing to continued hiring in construction and health care and investment tied to AI. (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: 美银市场策略主管乔·奎兰在彭博节目中表示，尽管7月就业数据疲软，但美国经济仍具韧性。他强调建筑业和医疗保健领域的持续招聘，以及与人工智能相关的投资，认为这些因素支撑股市。奎兰对美股持乐观态度。
summaries.en: Merrill & Bank of America's Joe Quinlan remains bullish on US stocks, citing resilience despite weak July jobs data. He highlights continued hiring in construction and healthcare, as well as investment in AI, as positive indicators for the economy. The summary reflects Quinlan's perspective on the market's strength.

items.title: Ceuta Migrant Surge Exposes Morocco’s Economic Strain
items.content: More than 70,000 people, mostly Moroccans, crossed into Spain’s North African enclave of Ceuta in a mass migration surge fueled by economic frustration and amplified by social media. Senior Researcher at Oxford University Centre on Migration, Policy & Society Myriam Cherti is on Bloomberg This Weekend to discuss the unusual influx of those looking to cross. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Weak Jobs Data Masked by Falling Unemployment
items.content: The US unexpectedly lost 23,000 jobs in July while unemployment fell to 4.1%, a decline driven by fewer people participating in the labor force rather than stronger employment. Bloomberg News Economics Chief US Economist Anna Wong joins Bloomberg This Weekend and explains to hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini that the weak payrolls and persistent downward revisions point to a softer labor market and could reduce pressure on the Fed to raise rates in September. (Source: Bloomberg)
items.contentSnippet: The US unexpectedly lost 23,000 jobs in July while unemployment fell to 4.1%, a decline driven by fewer people participating in the labor force rather than stronger employment. Bloomberg News Economics Chief US Economist Anna Wong joins Bloomberg This Weekend and explains to hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini that the weak payrolls and persistent downward revisions point to a softer labor market and could reduce pressure on the Fed to raise rates in September. (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.en: The US economy lost 23,000 jobs in July, with unemployment falling to 4.1% due to reduced labor force participation, not job growth. Weak payroll data and downward revisions suggest a softer labor market, potentially lessening the Federal Reserve's urgency to raise interest rates in September. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Fintech That Soared on Trump Sells Core Business for $12 Million
items.content: A virtually unknown fintech that catapulted into the headlines and cracked a $1 billion market value after signing a deal with the Trump family’s crypto platform last year has sold its core business for about $12 million.
items.contentSnippet: A virtually unknown fintech that catapulted into the headlines and cracked a $1 billion market value after signing a deal with the Trump family’s crypto platform last year has sold its core business for about $12 million.

items.title: Kyiv Struck as Ukraine Targets Two Russian Oil Refineries
items.content: A fire was sparked at Russia’s Ilsky oil refinery in the southern Krasnodar region by Ukrainian drone debris, injuring five people, the regional task force said on Saturday, as Russia and Ukraine exchanged overnight attacks including a large-scale missile barrage on Kyiv.

items.creator: Bloomberg News

summaries.zh: 基辅遭到袭击，乌克兰同时袭击俄罗斯炼油厂和“影子舰队”。俄罗斯克拉斯诺达尔地区的伊尔斯基炼油厂因乌克兰无人机碎片引发火灾，造成五人受伤。双方夜间互袭，包括对基辅的大规模导弹打击。
summaries.en: Ukraine targeted Russia’s Ilsky oil refinery in the Krasnodar region, causing a fire with drone debris that injured five people, according to regional officials. items.title: Burnham’s Fiscal ‘Flexibility’ Could Backfire, Officials Fear
items.content: UK Treasury officials are concerned that the prime minister’s talk of using “flexibility” within the fiscal rules to ramp up investment could backfire by destabilizing financial markets, according to people familiar with the thinking.
items.contentSnippet: UK Treasury officials are concerned that the prime minister’s talk of using “flexibility” within the fiscal rules to ramp up investment could backfire by destabilizing financial markets, according to people familiar with the thinking.

summaries.en: UK Treasury officials worry that Prime Minister Burnham's plan to use fiscal "flexibility" to boost investment might destabilize financial markets, sources say. The concern is that this approach could undermine confidence and create uncertainty.

items.title: War Brings Winter of Discontent for the World’s Workhorse Fuel
items.content: A diesel squeeze spurred by wars in the Middle East and Ukraine is setting the stage for an even worse crunch as demand rises ahead of the Northern Hemisphere winter.

summaries.en: The article highlights a diesel shortage caused by Middle Eastern and Ukrainian wars, leading to rising demand before the Northern Hemisphere winter. This situation is expected to worsen, creating a significant fuel crunch. The conflict has disrupted supply chains, exacerbating concerns about energy availability as winter approaches.

items.title: Situational Awareness’s Mystery Investment Was to Source Foundry
items.content: A mystery $400 million investment made by Situational Awareness just days after the hedge fund was on the brink of collapse was to chip manufacturing startup Source Foundry, according to people familiar with the matter.

summaries.zh: 据知情人士透露，在对冲基金Situational Awareness濒临破产数天后，该公司秘密投资了4亿美元于芯片制造初创公司Source Foundry。此次投资旨在帮助Source Foundry，但Situational Awareness的财务状况仍不明确。
